task.title: P6-121: Fix silent exits and dead picker in the move dialog
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Stage 1 — Destructive actions and data integrity). Original id: P6-121. Size: S. Specs: specs/app-ui.md, specs/ui-components.md.

**Three of the move dialog's exits are silent, and two of them are not the no-op they are commented as** (was `P6-024a` + `P6-024b`). `plan_move` has three `None` exits — destination became forbidden (`tree_manage.rs:1085-1087`), destination no longer exists (`:1088`), and the genuine "already there" (`:1090-1092`) — and the caller collapses all three into one `move_open.set(false)` whose comment names only the third (`:1124-1128`). `manage.error` is not even set, so the user sees the dialog close and believes the move happened. Separately, a pick does **nothing at all** — no feedback, dialog left open — when the tree resource reads `None` mid-refetch (`:1121-1123`) or when `busy` is set by another dialog's in-flight op (`:1129-1131`); `busy` is one shared `RwSignal` across all four dialogs, and `Dialog`'s ESC closes an overlay without cancelling its request, so "dismiss a slow Delete, then Move to…" is a reachable path to a dead picker.
